mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity valuations by raising discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces corporate borrowing and investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in private payrolls signal a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE rises by at least 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls by at least 50k over the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in residential construction permits relative to the 12-month moving average signals an impending slowdown in housing demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST falls below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the past 3 months indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPI) rises above 3.5% year-over-year for two consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL has exceeded 3.5% YoY for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and residential construction (HOUST) signal a broad-based weakening in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS falls by at least 0.5% and HOUST falls by at least 1% over the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of supply chain disruption, a decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average signals reduced manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of supply chain disruption periods when INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
